name: discover-layer-base-types-full
description: The `base_types` layer's descriptor at `form: "full"` — the one form that carries the descriptor PROSE, asked for one layer at a time because the project-wide `full` discovery is REFUSED with `over-budget` on every project (`negative/discover-project-full-over-budget.json`), and the refusal's second step is exactly this request. Together the fifteen per-layer `full` vectors replay every layer, kind and field annotation the model contract ships, verbatim, which is where the shipped-prose oracle (`packages/tools/tests/test_model_contract_conformance.py`) rides: rewording an annotation in the contract is a protocol-output change, and this is the output it changes. Of this layer: the layer contract `8.0.0` added when base types left `data_types`, stored one directory below it in `data_types/base/`, with exactly one kind, `base_type`, and therefore no discriminator — its `kind` field is an ordinary literal every file carries, still published immutable as it was while it was the discriminator: the contract's one immutability override. A value type's `base` is resolved in this layer alone.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` shape of a SWCraft project: fifteen scaffolded layers, `base_types` among them, holding the twelve platform base types in `data_types/base/`. Nothing about the response depends on which elements are in the layer: the inventory is derived from the model contract through the registry, not from the files.

layers.description: Base types, one file each under `data_types/base/`: how the platform stores a value — its size, its encoding and its C declaration. One kind, `base_type`, which a `value_type` names as its `base` and which no data element, argument, record field or array element names. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

element_kinds.description: A base type: how the platform stores a value — its size in bits, its encoding and its C declaration — emitted as a `SW-BASE-TYPE`. A base type is never what a data prototype is typed by (AUTOSAR's `AutosarDataPrototype.type`): no data element, argument, record field or array element may name one. A base type is an element of its own layer, `base_types`, so it may share its name with a type of another layer. A `value_type` names it as its `base`, and the data prototypes name the `value_type`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The type's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/base/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the base types, must not be blank, and immutable.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Always `base_type`. The layer holds one kind and is not discriminated; the field is an ordinary literal, kept, immutable as it was, so a base type file reads as it did when base types were a kind of the data types layer.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The size of the base type, in bits. Must be > 0.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: A required AUTOSAR BASE-TYPE-ENCODING token (NONE, 2C, IEEE754, ...); must not be blank, because a blank one is not round-trippable through the ARXML importer.

fields.name: native_declaration
fields.description: The C type name the generated code declares for this base type (for example `uint8_t`), emitted exactly as written as its `NATIVE-DECLARATION`. Required by check-model: SWCraft never derives one, so a base type without it still loads, but check-model reports it and ARXML generation refuses it until it is filled in.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free text about the type. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

fields.name: package
fields.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Base`, its layer's package, this base type is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the base type and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Base/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Base` itself. SWCraft's importers record it for an element whose source path is exactly `/DataTypes/Base/{package}/{name}`, SWCraft's own layout, so a project's export imports back placed; and for an element that would otherwise share `/DataTypes/Base` with a name differing from its own only in case. An author may set it to place an element or to resolve such a collision. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.

expected.notes: The same document the default form answers with `description` restored on the layer, on every kind and on every field that declares one, and with the three descriptor booleans spelled out where the default form omits them at `false` — `optional` on the layer, `required` and `immutable` on every field. Nothing else is restored, because nothing else is left out. `baseline` is the stand-in token every vector carries; a harness replaces it with the project's own.
